I'll track visited exception ids and thread that set through the recursive group extraction.

I fixed the traceback recursion in `rich/traceback.py` so cyclic exception chains no longer recurse forever. `Traceback.extract` now tracks visited exceptions by id and stops following a `__cause__`, `__context__`, or exception-group member that has already been seen.

Verification: two self-referencing cycles (a cause loop and a context loop) now extract without error, and `tests/test_traceback.py` passes (21 passed, 1 skipped). I did not add a regression test, and I did not reproduce the exact scenarios in issues #3682 and #3708 beyond these cycle shapes.
